clauses.clause_label: Source Available Portfolio License — read, clone, and study
clauses.scope_note: Permits reading, cloning, and studying this repository. The permission is for the repository itself; it does not grant rights to redistribute it, use it commercially, or incorporate it into third-party products.
clauses.condition_explanation: No additional condition is stated for reading, cloning, or studying.

clauses.clause_label: Source Available Portfolio License — redistribution, commercial use, and incorporation
clauses.scope_note: Redistribution and commercial use of the repository, and incorporating it into a third-party product, require explicit permission from the copyright holder, unless a later commit replaces this file with an open source license. CombinedProduct applies only to incorporation into a third-party product.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the copyright holder has not given explicit permission and this file has not been replaced by an open source license. The text does not specify the terms of any permission or later replacement license.

coverage_notes: The supplied text is a source-available portfolio license, not an identified standard software license. No terms are supplied for sublicensing, source provision, hosting or network access, training, attribution, fees, or rights in outputs; no such permissions or restrictions are inferred.
The permission to read, clone, and study is limited to those stated activities. The text does not establish a general grant for other uses or for modified artifacts.

The clause refers to explicit permission from the copyright holder and to a possible later commit replacing the file, but supplies no details about obtaining permission or the terms of any replacement license.
